title: Scorpion Shields vs Miserere Column
lede:
The Miserere Column beat the Scorpion Shields 31-28 on Victory Points at the end of Battle Round 6, coming from 25-28 down with one round to play.

The Golgothic Paladins and the Knight-Apostle Squad destroyed the Shields' Praetorian squads one by one in the centre, and in the last round the Shields' only surviving squad charged off the left objective, so the Column's 6 VP from the centre, the right and LEAD FROM THE FRONT went unanswered.
result_line: Miserere Column win 31-28 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Scorpion Shields (250 RP) brought seven elite Praetorian units on row 12 in front of their HQ at (7,13): Praetorian Tribune 1 leading Praetorian Strikers 1 at 10,12, Praetorian Tribune 2 leading Praetorian Gunners 1 at 6,12, Praetorian Strikers 2 at 3,12, Praetorian Gunners 2 at 5,12 and the Praetorian Fireteam at 11,12; every squad has 3 models and 9 HP. The Miserere Column (246 RP) set up on row 2 in front of its HQ at (7,1): Cain - The First Penitent leading the Knight-Apostle Squad at 9,2, the Cantor-Preceptor leading Covenant Levies 1 at 3,2, Covenant Levies 2, 3 and 4 at 6,2, 8,2 and 5,2, the Jordanite Hospitallers at 4,2 and the Golgothic Paladins at 11,2. The Shields had Priority with fewer units (8 to 10). It was quality against bodies: the Shields' strikers kill a 20-HP Levies squad in one charge, but they had no unit to spare for a third objective, and the Column had four Levies to feed into the centre and 60 RP of Paladins behind them.

1.title: Row 7 reached, and DEEP REACH paid at once

feed.text: Primaries revealed: BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Shields, LEAD FROM THE FRONT for the Column. Secondaries kept: FOCUSED FIRE and DEEP REACH. Both sides spent 2 CP on a Double Time: the Shields on Praetorian Strikers 1, the Column on Covenant Levies 3.

Praetorian Strikers 1 with Praetorian Tribune 1 Advanced 10,12 to 8,7, into the centre's area, and Covenant Levies 3 came up to 6,7 opposite with Covenant Levies 2 behind at 6,6. Praetorian Strikers 2 reached the left objective at 2,8, with the Jordanite Hospitallers opposite at 1,6; Praetorian Gunners 2 and the Fireteam went to 8,8 and 10,8. The Column's heavy units stayed back: the Golgothic Paladins at 8,4, Cain and the Knight-Apostle Squad at 5,3.

One attack: Praetorian Gunners 2 shot Covenant Levies 2 for 5 (20 to 15), with the Column's Fortitude Miracle on the target. Mandata Principum activated the Praetorian Fireteam next, and it had nothing to do; every other unit had no legal action.

The Column won the centre on OC 18 vs 14 (3 VP) and the Shields the left on OC 6 vs 3 (2 VP). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 1 for the Shields' units in the centre the Column held; DEEP REACH paid the Column 3 (the three objectives are equally far from its HQ). Pietas +4 for the Shields (the log line; the round's snapshot reads 0), and PRAYING gave the Column 13 Mana. 3-6.

2.title: Praetorian Strikers 1 wipes out Covenant Levies 3; the Paladins answer

feed.text: Benediction healed Covenant Levies 2 by 1. The Shields spent 2 CP on Double Time for Praetorian Gunners 1; the Column spent 3 CP on Troop Requisition, a Covenant Levies at 6,2. New secondaries: FORWARD PRESENCE for the Shields, OMNIPRESENCE for the Column; FOCUSED FIRE expired.

The Praetorian Fireteam walked 10,8 to 8,6 into Overwatch: Covenant Levies 2 hit it for 3 with Providence through the Shields' Go to Ground (1 CP). Praetorian Gunners 1 and Tribune 2 used the Double Time to reach 1,8, on the left. Their Overwatch at Covenant Levies 1 rolled almost nothing: Tribune 2's Volcanus Pistol and the squad's pistols were skipped (FREE weapon already used this Battle Round) and the carbines missed. Then the charges: Praetorian Strikers 2 to 5,7 into Covenant Levies 2 and 3, Strikers 1 and Tribune 1 to 7,8 into Covenant Levies 3, and the Golgothic Paladins to 8,5 into the Fireteam. Covenant Levies 2 broke away to 5,5.

Praetorian Strikers 1's Thermic Falcatas destroyed Covenant Levies 3 (16 and 4); Retribution let the Levies swing back for one hit and no damage, and the Strikers took ground at 6,7. Praetorian Gunners 2, activated next by Mandata Principum, spent its action on Marksman Mode, which bought nothing. The Golgothic Paladins, with Exaltation, destroyed the Praetorian Fireteam (6, 35 RP) and took ground at 8,6. Praetorian Gunners 1's Raking Bursts put two volleys into Covenant Levies 4 (20 to 10), and the Knight-Apostle Squad's Relic Pistols hit Strikers 1 for 3 (9 to 6). Cain's Patriarch of the Covenant restored Retribution, and the Cantor-Preceptor cast Introit on Covenant Levies 1 (2 Mana).

The Shields took the centre on OC 6 vs 6, on the tie-break of more units there (Strikers 1 and Tribune 1 against the Paladins), and the left on OC 8 vs 5 (5 VP); BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for the centre taken from the Column. The Column scored nothing. 11-6.

3.title: The Column names the centre, and the Shields take it

feed.text: The Shields spent 5 CP on Troop Requisition, a Legionnaire Squad at 6,12, and kept TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET; the Column picked the centre for it. The Column spent 2 CP on Double Time for Cain - The First Penitent, which bought nothing, and kept COORDINATED PUSH.

Praetorian Strikers 2 charged to 6,6 into Cain, the Knight-Apostle Squad, Covenant Levies 2 and the Jordanite Hospitallers; Covenant Levies 2 failed its Fall Back test (1 HP) and went to 5,4. Gunners 1 with Tribune 2 and Strikers 1 with Tribune 1 both charged Covenant Levies 4 on the left, which failed its test (1 HP) and fell back to 4,4. Covenant Levies 1 and the Cantor-Preceptor went to 0,6, on the left objective. The Golgothic Paladins charged to 7,8 into Praetorian Gunners 2. Tribune 2's Overwatch on the requisitioned Covenant Levies skipped its FREE pistol again.

Praetorian Strikers 2 destroyed the Jordanite Hospitallers (9, 15 RP); Retribution's swing back did nothing. The Golgothic Paladins put 3 into Gunners 2 (9 to 6). Praetorian Gunners 1 used Marksman Mode, which again bought nothing. The Knight-Apostle Squad took Strikers 2 from 9 to 3; Cain missed. Covenant Levies 1 and the requisitioned Levies shot Gunners 1 for 1. The Cantor-Preceptor cast Introit on Covenant Levies 1 again (2 Mana) and changed nothing.

The Shields held the centre on OC 6 vs 6, again on the tie-break (Strikers 2 and Gunners 2 against the Paladins), for 3 VP and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET's 3. The Column won the left on OC 11 vs 8 (2 VP). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Shields 1 for Gunners 1 in the left's area; LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid the Column 3, counting the Cantor-Preceptor and the Covenant Levies 1 it leads as two. 18-11.

4.title: Five units destroyed; the centre goes to Cain

feed.text: The Shields spent 2 CP on Double Time for the Legionnaire Squad. The Column spent 5: Troop Requisition (3) for a second Covenant Levies at 8,2, and Double Time (2) on it. New secondaries: FORWARD DEPLOYMENT for the Shields, SECURE THE FLANKS for the Column.

The Legionnaire Squad went 4,11 to 8,10 and the second requisitioned Levies 8,2 to 11,5. Strikers 1 and Tribune 1 charged from 3,7 to 1,6 into the Cantor-Preceptor and Covenant Levies 1 on the left objective. Covenant Levies 4 walked to 4,7 and Gunners 1 with Tribune 2 charged to 3,8 into it; Tribune 2's Overwatch on the way rolled nothing again.

Gunners 1 put 3 into Covenant Levies 4 (9 to 6); Strikers 1, activated next by Mandata Principum, did 14 to Covenant Levies 1 (20 to 6) and Tribune 1 finished it. In the centre the Knight-Apostle Squad destroyed Praetorian Strikers 2 (3 HP) and took ground at 6,6, and the Golgothic Paladins destroyed Praetorian Gunners 2 (6 HP) for 1 damage back. The first requisitioned Covenant Levies fired into the melee at 4,7 and its shot was resolved against Covenant Levies 4 (Friendly Fire), 2 damage; Tribune 2 then destroyed Covenant Levies 4 and took ground at 4,7. The Legionnaire Squad raised Shield Wall.

The Column took the centre on OC 17 vs 0 (3 VP) with Cain, the Knight-Apostle Squad and the Paladins; the Shields took the left on OC 6 vs 0 (2 VP) and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for taking it from the Column. LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid 3 for Cain, the Knight-Apostle Squad and the Cantor-Preceptor, alive alone at 0,6. Pietas reached Tier V. 23-17.
No commands. New secondaries: DEEP REACH for the Shields, FORWARD PRESENCE for the Column.

The Legionnaire Squad moved to 9,8 and Covenant Levies 2 into the centre at 7,7. The first requisitioned Levies failed its Fall Back test from Gunners 1 and Tribune 2 (2 HP) and went to 5,4; the second walked to 12,6, on the right objective. When the Golgothic Paladins moved to charge, Tribune 2 spent 3 CP on a Countercharge: Praetorian Gunners 1 and Tribune 2 charged from 4,7 to 6,7, into Cain, the Knight-Apostle Squad, Covenant Levies 2 and the Paladins, and the Paladins' charge was cancelled.

Tribune 2 hit the Knight-Apostle Squad for 2 (12 to 10); the counterattacks from the squad and Cain took 5 off Gunners 1 (8 to 3), and the Gunners' hits on Cain did nothing. The Golgothic Paladins then destroyed Gunners 1 and Tribune 2 together (3 and 6, 70 RP) and took ground at 6,7. On the left, Strikers 1 destroyed the Cantor-Preceptor; the Reprieve Miracle brought it back at 2 HP and Tribune 1 destroyed it again. Covenant Levies 2 shot the Legionnaire Squad for 1 through Go to Ground (1 CP).

The Column held the centre on OC 25 vs 0 and the right on OC 10 vs 0 (5 VP), and LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid 3 (9 of 10). The Shields held the left on OC 6 vs 0 (2 VP) and completed DEEP REACH (3); BREAK THEIR HOLD paid nothing, with no Shields unit left in an objective the Column held. 28-25.

6.title: The Strikers leave the left; the Column takes the last 6

feed.text: The Shields spent 2 CP on Double Time for Praetorian Strikers 1 and kept IRON GRIP. The Column spent nothing and held 5 CP. Five secondaries expired as the Movement Phase began, among them the Shields' FORWARD PRESENCE and FORWARD DEPLOYMENT.

Praetorian Strikers 1 and Tribune 1 charged from 1,6, on the left objective, to 4,4 into the first requisitioned Covenant Levies, which failed its test (3 HP) and broke away to 5,6. The Legionnaire Squad charged to 8,7 into Covenant Levies 2 in the centre, which broke away to 5,9. The Golgothic Paladins and the Knight-Apostle Squad with Cain charged the Legionnaire Squad; the second requisitioned Levies moved to 13,8, still on the right objective.

The Legionnaire Squad hit the Golgothic Paladins for 1 (14 to 13) and took 7 from their counterattack (9 to 2); the Knight-Apostle Squad finished it and took ground at 8,7. Tribune 1 fired at the Column's HQ and missed, and Strikers 1 had no legal action.
The Column held the centre on OC 17 vs 0 and the right on OC 10 vs 0 (5 VP), and LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid its last 1 (10 of 10). Nobody held the left. 28-31, the Column past the 30 VP target.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Miserere Column took 18 of its 31 VP from objectives: the centre in Rounds 1, 4, 5 and 6 (12), the right in Rounds 5 and 6 (4) and the left in Round 3 (2). LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid 10 (3, 3, 3 and 1, at its cap) and DEEP REACH 3; none of its other four secondaries was completed. The Scorpion Shields scored 14 objective VP (the left in Rounds 1, 2, 4 and 5, the centre in Rounds 2 and 3), 8 from BREAK THEIR HOLD (1, 3, 1, 3) and 6 from TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET and DEEP REACH. The Shields led from Round 2 to Round 5; their VP stopped when their units did. BREAK THEIR HOLD pays only while Shields units stand in objectives the enemy holds, and from Round 5 nothing of theirs was left in the centre.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

For the Column, the Golgothic Paladins (60 RP) did 31 damage and destroyed four units: the Praetorian Fireteam, Praetorian Gunners 2, and Praetorian Gunners 1 with Praetorian Tribune 2. The Knight-Apostle Squad did 16 and destroyed Praetorian Strikers 2 and the Legionnaire Squad; with Cain it scored 5.8 VP each, mostly the Primary. Cain himself made an attack and a counterattack in six rounds, 3 damage (inaction 3). The second requisitioned Covenant Levies walked onto the right objective in Round 5 and scored 4.0 VP for 10 RP.

For the Shields, Praetorian Strikers 1 did the most damage on the table (38) and, with Praetorian Tribune 1, scored 7.3 VP each, taking the centre in Round 2 and holding the left in Rounds 4 and 5. Praetorian Strikers 2 took the left in Round 1 and, with Praetorian Gunners 2, the centre and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET in Round 3 (5.0 VP), and destroyed the Jordanite Hospitallers. Praetorian Gunners 1's Raking Bursts did 10 damage in one action; both Marksman Modes bought nothing. Praetorian Tribune 2 fired three Overwatch reactions and rolled no dice in any of them (below).

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Shields could not do

Trade. They did more damage, 91 to 55, but most of it went into 10 RP Levies squads: they destroyed 66 RP, the Column 195. They won the early fights and took the lead, but every Praetorian squad that ended next to the Paladins or the Knight-Apostle Squad died: six of their eight units were destroyed, against five of the Column's, all of those cheap (10 to 21 RP), and by Round 6 Strikers 1 and Tribune 1 were all that was left. An army of seven 9-HP squads cannot lose a squad a round and still hold two objectives, and the Shields never sent anything to the right objective at all.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 6, the left objective: Praetorian Strikers 1 and Tribune 1 held it on OC 6 vs 0 in Rounds 4 and 5. With the Shields on 28, the AI spent 2 CP on Double Time to charge them off it to 4,4, into a Covenant Levies that broke away, and they then had no legal action. Staying would have scored 2 VP and put the Shields on 30, though the Column's 31 would still have won (when both pass the target, the higher VP wins).
  • Round 5, Countercharge: 3 CP sent Praetorian Gunners 1 and Tribune 2 into Cain, the Knight-Apostle Squad, Covenant Levies 2 and the Paladins at once. They did 2 damage and both died that phase (70 RP); the record prices the Countercharge at nothing, and the Fall Back record calls Gunners 1's stay should have left.
  • Overwatch with a FREE weapon rolls nothing (the known engine bug): Praetorian Tribune 2's Volcanus Pistol was skipped in Rounds 2, 3 and 4 (FREE weapon already used this Battle Round), and Praetorian Gunners 1's pistols in Round 2. Three of Tribune 2's reactions did no damage without rolling a die.
  • The Column's CP: it spent nothing in Rounds 5 and 6 and finished with 5 CP unused; its Double Times on Covenant Levies 3 and on Cain bought nothing. Its 24 Mana was never spent after the two Introits on Covenant Levies 1, both priced at nothing.
  • The Fall Back record holds 5 charge-planning probes among its 20 stayed decisions (the Jordanite Hospitallers' risky hold and four holds by Praetorian Strikers 1, Praetorian Gunners 1 and Praetorian Gunners 2 in Rounds 2 and 3, the nearest engager 2 or 3 squares away).

Mostly the army, with the AI deciding the margin. The Column's Paladins and Knight-Apostles out-fought the Praetorians once the Levies had been spent, and the Column's objective count grew as the Shields' units died. The AI made the end worse for the Shields: a Countercharge that lost two units in Round 5 and a charge that gave up 2 VP on the left objective in Round 6, in a battle decided by 3.

closing: The Shields' Praetorians killed Levies all battle and led for four rounds. The Column fed them its cheap squads, then its Paladins and Knight-Apostles destroyed the Praetorians one by one, and in the last round the Shields had too few units left to hold the ground their lead was built on.
